stem: Amy has to choose a random sample from the 265 students in her year at college. She numbers the students from 1 to 265 and then uses random numbers generated by her calculator. The first two random numbers produced by her calculator are $0.213\,165\,448$ and $0.073\,165\,196$.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Use these figures to find the numbers of the first four students in her sample.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.stem:
There were 25 students in Amy’s sample. She asked each of them how much money, $x$, they earned in a week, on average. Her results are summarised below.

$$n = 25 \qquad \Sigma x = 510 \qquad \Sigma x^2 = 13\,225$$
parts.text: Find unbiased estimates of the population mean and variance.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text: Explain briefly what is meant by ‘population’ in this question.
